_comment: EXAMPLE MCP config for the PrimeNG -> Angular Material migration. Gate 3 of ui-migration-rules requires BOTH servers present and reachable (PrimeNG MCP for the old API, Material-side MCP for the new API + build/devserver validation). Copy the relevant entries into the repo's .mcp.json (project-level) or ~/.claude.json (user-level). Verify with: for the PrimeNG MCP, call list or version; for the Material-side MCP, call run_target or list_projects.

_verified.primeng: @primeng/mcp is published on npm (verified 2026-11); its README documents `npx -y @primeng/mcp` as the public command and `claude mcp add primeng -- npx -y @primeng/mcp` for Claude Code
_verified.angular-cli: VERIFIED 2026-11 — `@angular/cli` ships a built-in `mcp` subcommand (`ng mcp`), so `npx -y @angular/cli mcp` is a valid stdio entry (NEW-side docs + build/devserver validation). In a real project pass `--root <abs-path-to-project>`.
_verified.ngm-dev-blocks: VERIFIED 2026-11 — the dedicated Angular Material generator from ui.angular-material.dev/docs/mcp. `npx -y @ngm-dev/cli mcp <abs-project-dir>` exposes get-all-block-names / generate-angular-material-block / setup-angular-material-blocks. Complements angular-cli (generator writes the new Material+Tailwind code; angular-cli validates it)

primeng._comment: PrimeNG MCP — audit the OLD PrimeNG usage (component API, template syntax, behavior). Exposes mcp__primeng__* tools (list, version, get_component, search, get_example, validate_usage).

angular-cli._comment: NEW-side Angular/Material docs + build/devserver VALIDATION (ng mcp). Verified: `@angular/cli` ships an `mcp` subcommand. In a real project add `--root <abs-project-dir>`. Exposes mcp__angular-cli__* (get_best_practices, search_documentation, list_projects, run_target, devserver_*).

ngm-dev-blocks._comment: DEDICATED Angular Material MCP (ui.angular-material.dev/docs/mcp) — GENERATE new Material + Tailwind blocks. Verified: `@ngm-dev/cli mcp <dir>` exposes mcp__ngm-dev-blocks__* (setup-angular-material-blocks, generate-angular-material-block, get-all-block-names). Replace `full/path/to/angular/project` with the actual project dir before use. Complementary to angular-cli (which does docs + validation).
